senses.gloss:
adv. n. (-ढं) adj. mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Excessive, much, very much, heavy, oppressive, &c.
2 Firm, strong.
3 Hard.
4 Close.
E.
गाह to agitate, affix क्त, deriv. irr.

f. (-ता)
1 Firmness, hardness.
2 Excess.
E.
गाढ, and तल् affix; also with त्व, गाढत्वं.

mfn. (-ष्ठिः-ष्ठिः-ष्ठि)
Miserly, niggard, avaricious, closefisted.
m. (-ष्ठिः)
A scymitar, a large sacrificial knife.
E.
गाढ heavy or close, and मुष्ठि gripe.
